amendments.authorised_by: Claude (cycle 146 relay agent)
amendments.what: Root-caused via a live local run + temporary debug logging (reverted, see the send-introduction.ts diff history): tryReserveSendSlotInTransaction (src/server/mailbox/sending-policy.ts) permanently refuses a RELEASED idempotency key ('a prior attempt for this idempotency key is finished') and the caller folds that refusal into the generic 'No mailbox capacity remaining' message, which is real, intentional duplicate-send protection, not a bug. Re-running the e2e seed against a PERSISTENT local database (not a fresh CI one) therefore made the Launch fixture's step-send permanently undispatchable after its first real attempt. Added a delete-then-reset of this fixture's MailboxSendReservation + OutboundEmail rows on every seed run, mirroring the AI-spend/replies delete-then-recreate pattern already in this file, so the fixture is truly idempotent across repeated local runs, not just against a fresh CI database.
